scenes.title: Hook: the lock face
scenes.purpose: [hook] Hero object on screen from frame 1, then the question.
scenes.why: Raises the question the mechanism answers.
on_screen_text: Why does only one key turn it?
scenes.visual: Front view of the lock face; the gap ring draws; the keyway pulses.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

scenes.title: Map: the lock cut open
scenes.purpose: [map] Draw the whole system once and label it.
scenes.why: Names the parts the rest of the film reuses.
on_screen_text: Five pin stacks bridge the gap between the plug and the housing.
scenes.visual: Section view draws; pin stacks assemble; shear line and labels with leaders.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: The hero object persists; only its state changes.

scenes.title: Trace: the right key
scenes.purpose: [trace] One gap lit at a time as the right key lifts it.
scenes.why: Shows why the right key works.
on_screen_text: The right key lifts every gap to the shear line.
scenes.visual: Key slides in; pins ride up; stacks dim, then each gap lights on the shear line.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

beats.action: key slides in, pins ride up

transition_out.continuity: The hero object persists; only its state changes.

scenes.title: Failure: the wrong key
scenes.purpose: [failure-or-limit] Break one part and show the consequence.
scenes.why: Names the part that blocks the system.
on_screen_text: One pin too high, and the plug cannot turn.
scenes.visual: Key withdraws; wrong key enters; pin 3 crosses the line, turns red; BLOCKED stamp; plug shakes.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

scenes.title: Takeaway: back to the face
scenes.purpose: [takeaway] Bookend: the opening object in its resolved state.
scenes.why: Restates the one idea over the resolved object.
on_screen_text: Every gap on one line. Then it turns.
scenes.visual: Front view returns; the key fills the slot; the plug turns 90 degrees; closing line.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.
